text:
marta: hi! just trying to finish onboarding stops at Okta MFA. sms never arrives to my brazil number (+55). anyone else seen carrier blocks down there?
it-support: hey marta, welcome! yes occasional international SMS drop happens. did you enter the full E.164 number? what's the last 4 digits so we can confirm?
marta: full number ends with 8890. i double-checked. i can get SMS from banks and whatsapp, so odd. tried on mobile data + home wifi.
people-ops: @marta we can issue temporary access while we sort MFA. what do you need first (drive, slack, github)? also looks like the 1Password invite was sent to your personal gmail — can you confirm the correct work email?
marta: need team drive + repo access. work email should be marta@redwood.ai (i accidentally typed marta.dev@gmail on the form).
access-admin: thanks. resending 1Password + Okta invite to marta@redwood.ai now. policy note: org licenses delay SSO seat sometimes by up to 15 minutes.
onboarding-bot: Okta invite resent to marta@redwood.ai (sent). 1Password invite resent to marta@redwood.ai (sent).
it-support: while invites propagate, we can: (1) generate Okta backup codes, (2) enroll you in Okta Verify (app) instead of SMS, or (3) set a temporary MFA bypass for 24h. which do you prefer?
marta: app would be great — i already use Authy. does that work?
it-support: yup Authy/Google Authenticator work. when you get the Okta prompt choose "Set up another authenticator app" and scan the qr. if you get stuck DM me and i'll send a manual TOTP token.
devops: for github access we need your SSH public key. drop it here or put into the secure 1Password note once you have access.
marta: pasting key: ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQC3... marta@redwood.ai
access-admin: added marta to org-members and gave repo:platform-docs Write access temporarily. added to Team Drive with Viewer role; upgraded to Editor after you confirm 1P enrollment.
marta: got 1Password finally, enrolled okta via Authy, used one backup code as extra step. logged into Slack and Drive. thanks!
people-ops: yay! pro tip: switch to app-based auth in your Authn settings > MFA and register a security key (we recommend a hardware key for EU/APAC folks). onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.ai/onboard/checklist
it-support: note for infra: marta's device trust shows unknown for device-trust policy. @devops can you add device approval on first-login?
devops: approved device trust for marta's session. please confirm MacOS device name in profile.
marta: confirmed laptop name: MARTA-M1. excited to start today :)
people-ops: welcome Marta :partyparrot: intro call at 3pm — see you then.
